remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Ida O'Keeffe was one of the artist's four sisters. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Sketch of the artist's sister's head and shoulders in profile. Image is in the center of the paper surrounded by negative space on all sides. The subject is facing towards the right side of the paper, with her head tilted slightly downward toward her chest. Her hair is in a loose braid and the collar of her shirt is lightly drawn in. The negative space which defines the area around the face is darkly shaded.
title: Untitled (Ida O'Keeffe)
